description: This file defines the class RelationalOrleansQueries, which provides methods for interacting with Orleans system storage using relational databases. It includes methods for reading and writing reminders, membership data, stream messages, and grain directory entries, with conditional compilation for different Orleans subsystems.

classes.name: RelationalOrleansQueries
classes.description: A class providing methods for interacting with Orleans system storage via relational databases, supporting reminders, membership, streaming, and grain directory operations with conditional compilation.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates and initializes an instance of RelationalOrleansQueries by setting up storage and loading queries from the database.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Executes a non-query command against the relational storage.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Performs a read operation from the storage, applying selector, parameter, and aggregator functions.

methods.name: ReadReminderRowsAsync
methods.description: Reads reminder data for a specific grain or range of hashes.

methods.name: GetQueryKeyAndValue
methods.description: Extracts a key-value pair from a data record representing a stored query.

methods.name: GetReminderEntry
methods.description: Converts a data record into a ReminderEntry object, parsing fields like GrainId, ReminderName, StartAt, Period, and ETag.

methods.name: ReadReminderRowAsync
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry for a grain.

methods.name: UpsertReminderRowAsync
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder row and returns the new version etag.

methods.name: DeleteReminderRowAsync
methods.description: Deletes a specific reminder row based on serviceId, grainId, reminderName, and etag.

methods.name: DeleteReminderRowsAsync
methods.description: Deletes all reminder rows for a given serviceId.

methods.name: ActiveGatewaysAsync
methods.description: Lists active gateway URIs for a deployment.

methods.name: MembershipReadRowAsync
methods.description: Reads membership data for a specific silo address.

methods.name: MembershipReadAllAsync
methods.description: Reads all membership data for a deployment.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntriesAsync
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a deployment.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntriesAsync
methods.description: Removes defunct silo entries based on last alive time.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAliveTimeAsync
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a silo.

methods.name: InsertMembershipVersionRowAsync
methods.description: Inserts a version row if it does not exist, returning whether insertion succeeded.

methods.name: InsertMembershipRowAsync
methods.description: Inserts a new membership row if it does not exist.

methods.name: UpdateMembershipRowAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing membership row.

methods.name: ConvertToMembershipTableData
methods.description: Converts raw database query results into MembershipTableData.

methods.name: QueueStreamMessageAsync
methods.description: Queues a stream message for delivery.

methods.name: GetStreamMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves stream messages from the storage.

methods.name: ConfirmStreamMessagesAsync
methods.description: Confirms delivery of stream messages.

methods.name: FailStreamMessageAsync
methods.description: Marks a stream message as failed.

methods.name: EvictStreamMessagesAsync
methods.description: Moves messages to dead letter storage.

methods.name: EvictStreamDeadLettersAsync
methods.description: Removes expired dead letter messages.

methods.name: RegisterGrainActivationAsync
methods.description: Registers a new grain activation in the directory.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainActivationAsync
methods.description: Unregisters a grain activation.

methods.name: LookupGrainActivationAsync
methods.description: Looks up a grain activation.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainActivationsAsync
methods.description: Unregisters all grain activations for specified silos.
